ops.note: Bench emulation: each router BF phase carries its own K segment of x at the SAME VM addresses (compiled field), so the bench reloads VM from p<ph>/vm.hex at each go (+PHASE_VM=1); values of every row are golden-checked, so a premature overwrite would fail. FLOOR CAUSE (RTL, schedule constraint): at P <= 230 the returned VALUES are still correct but each BF return word carries the NEXT phase's segment index (RET 408 tagged lo 1 instead of 0 when go 1 is at <= go0+230) -> the frame samples the BF segment label from live phase config ~232 edges after go while the spine already reports ready; static schedules must space BF router gos >= 231 (or the label must be pipelined with the op). Old 977.2 priced 96 rows in one phase on the old canonical placement; the p4l-MU release field runs 5 serial BF segment phases per frame -> slower (+45%).

dag_overlap.consumer: L<n>.attn.idx.q (SU qbank 93: RoPE + FP4 QDQ of the index q) -> L<n>.attn.idx.score (2951) -> L<n>.attn.idx.topk_local (2177); also L<n>.attn.idx.q -> L<n>.attn.idx.newkey (non-critical)
dag_overlap.concurrent_with_priced_node: NO on the field: on the release die the indexer.wq_b rows are field phases 12..17 on the SAME 8 frames of every slice, right after wq_b phases 1..11 (field order XS_OPS L2 = wq_b, idx.q, ...), so they serialize behind wq_b (+757 at P 126), not in parallel with it. The SU qbank (93) step overlaps L<n>.attn.q_rope (117.6, same start, both after wq_b) in the DAG.
dag_overlap.already_priced: YES: ds_rom.json L2/8/14/20/24/28/32/36.attn.wq_b = 1559.6 prices 12288 rows = 8192 wq_b + 4096 indexer.wq_b rows over 2 phases (+289 die wire +28 tiles), vs 1039.9 / 8192 rows in the other 32 layers. A separate idx.q field node in series would DOUBLE COUNT unless the sparse-layer wq_b node is re-priced as wq_b only.
dag_overlap.suggested_fold: either (a) sparse-layer L<n>.attn.wq_b by_old 1559.6 -> 2311 + its tail 317 = 2628 (merged field, measured) and no new node; or (b) L<n>.attn.wq_b -> 1554 + 317 = 1871 and a new node L<n>.attn.idx.q_field = 757 between wq_b and the SU qbank (L<n>.attn.idx.q 93).
